messages.content: Help me asynchronously store the value 'John Doe' with the key 'employee:1234' in a Redisson map cache and ensure it's processed correctly?

function.name: RedissonMapCache_putOperationAsync
function.description: Asynchronously stores a key-value pair in the Redisson map cache. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

key.description: The key under which the value is to be stored in the map cache. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

value.description: The value associated with the key to be stored in the map cache. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
